# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 17 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 17:1 — oil of mercy — key term

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "oil of mercy from the tree of mercy" | Literal oleum misericordiae de ligno misericordiae |
| LOGOS | "oil of mercy from the tree of mercy" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "oil of mercy from the tree of mercy" | Same — all agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three agree. The 'oil of mercy' (oleum misericordiae) is the text's central healing symbol and must be preserved as such. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
